thesis_statement: Alphabet pairs a highly profitable Search and YouTube advertising franchise with a fast-growing Google Cloud business and its own full AI stack (Gemini models plus TPU chips), giving it several ways to turn AI demand into revenue; the open question is the return on record capital spending.

base.summary: Revenue grows around 15-20% with Cloud leading while Search holds up and operating margin stays in the low-to-mid 30s.
drivers: Google Cloud AI infrastructure and Gemini Enterprise

bull.summary: Cloud sustains very high growth on AI demand and capex converts into margin expansion and renewed free cash flow.

bear.summary: AI assistants erode search usage while capex keeps free cash flow negative and investors question the returns.
drivers: capex returns below cost of capital

key_risks: Free cash flow turned negative in Q2 2026 (-$5.9B): capex $44.9B exceeded operating cash flow $39.1B.
GAAP EPS (+294%) is dominated by a $98.0B net unrealized gain on equity securities; it is not operating growth and can reverse.
Regulatory risk from the US search and ad-tech antitrust cases and remedies.

invalidation_reasons.price: Close below the live guarded-SQL reference_invalidation_level (313.17 at the 2026-09-26 renewal). SQL governs after any later renewal; this text does not.
fundamental: Google Search & other revenue growth falls below 5% year over year for two consecutive quarters.
Google Cloud growth drops below 30% while quarterly capex keeps rising, or operating margin falls below 30% for two quarters.

evidence.claim: Q2 2026: revenue $119.8B +24%; Services $94.5B +15% (Search +17%, YouTube ads +13%); Cloud $24.8B +82%; operating margin 34% (+2 pts); other income $98.0B mostly unrealized equity gains; EPS $9.11 +294%
Q2 OCF $39.07B, capex $44.92B, FCF -$5.86B; trailing P/E 17.1 (distorted by gains), forward P/E 22.9; net margin 93.65% (gain-inflated)
SQL band 325.63-341.85, invalidation 313.17, reference_confidence 50; close 341.03 on 2026-09-25 is inside band

owner_notes: Business momentum is strong, but conviction is held at medium until capex shows returns, since Q2 free cash flow was negative.
